name: ENKI Watch Intent Vocabulary Pack
description: Defines the watch intent modes (bounded, persistent, conditional) that drive track segmentation. Watch intents live on cases, threads, and watchlists; the track segmenter consults all active intents that reference an entity to decide when to open and close track segments.
